node.statement: Direct polar inclusion without sibling dependence: take the universal constants C_pol=P and kappa_pol<=q from the established lem-stage1-polar-retraction. Under the root hypothesis P*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_pol<=q, that lemma applies and, for t=delta-P*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2), gives calU_t subseteq S_delta. The root margin 600*epsilon_r<t also gives t>0.
